title: clinopodium dolichodontum
intro: Clinopodium dolichodontum, commonly known as Long-toothed Calamint, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family. It is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium dolichodontum are attributed to its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as rosmarinic acid, caffeic acid, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are also believed to possess neuroprotective and anti-cancer properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy in these areas.
